name: lytekeepr-linkedin
description: Brings your LinkedIn messages into LyteKeepr and sends the ones you approve, from this computer. Your LinkedIn login stays here.
long_description: Reads your LinkedIn messages on this computer, with your own LinkedIn login, and puts them in your LyteKeepr workspace: the last 3 months the first time, then every hour from 8am to 9pm while this computer and Claude are on. It sends a LinkedIn message only after you approved its exact text in LyteKeepr or Claude. It never posts anything. Claude sees two tools: sync LinkedIn and LinkedIn status.

tools.name: sync_linkedin
tools.description: Bring the newest LinkedIn messages into LyteKeepr now.

tools.name: linkedin_status
tools.description: Whether LinkedIn is connected and when it last synced.
